_doc: Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Frames are real art, generated deterministically by game/tools/art/address_me.gd (the shared pipeline skips this enemy because it has art/address_me.gd). Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083 (research/fable-tickets.md section 1.10 - the table is the spec; ENEMIES.md frozen, D-040). One entry per state of the section 1.10 table. Frames are file names relative to this folder. cycle_00.png is the normal frame (the spec's addressme_00); cycle_01.png is the explode frame (the spec's addressme_01: Image 14 composited over the elephant at 30% alpha); spawn_00.png / telegraph_00.png / leaves_00.png are the per-state derivatives (spawn brightness flash, telegraph desaturated+dimmed hold, leaves 1.18x/0.78y squash). All six PNGs are real art, generated deterministically by game/tools/art/address_me.gd - a later shared-pipeline rebuild SKIPS this enemy (it has art/address_me.gd). Tick ranges, the loop flags and the effect parameters are exactly as the table says. Driven by the SIM state and its tick counter, never a wall-clock timer.

spawn.timing_note: 12 ticks, FASTER than the common fade - its trumpet is the tell ([CONTESTABLE], section 1.10); appears 6 u in front of the player; only under the SR-4 scheduling gate (DESIGN.md section 5.10): no enemy body within 12 u, no ring/patch on the player, grounded, not on glitched floor

telegraph.timing_note: 300 ticks (5.0 s), binding; table 'loop' (a single held frame, looped). A red ring around the sprite drains clockwise over the 300 ticks; the sprite's tint goes neutral -> amber at tick 150 -> red at tick 240; a green stillness arc fills while the player is still (90 ticks = 1.5 s) and empties the moment they move. If the arc fills, 'leaves' plays; if 300 ticks expire first, the explode frame shows on tick 300 = the tick the kill resolves

leaves.timing_note: 18 ticks; answered = the player held still for 1.5 continuous seconds (speed < 0.5 u/s on all axes, no movement/jump/ability input); it shrinks to 0 with a soft puff

attack.timing_note: shown on tick 300 = the tick the kill resolves; 24 ticks; full-screen white flash for 6 ticks (section 1.10)

recover.timing_note: table: '30-45 s away (-5 s per extra vote, min 15-30 s)' - nothing on screen; the attack frame is shown, no recover animation is defined

name: address me
